answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making every vertex of power cost a non-refundable bond: each identity posts a bond that is burned to activate, so a farmer minting a thousand fake agents pays a thousand times. Bonds feed a public insurance pool that pays bounties to anyone who proves an identity is fake, turning honest agents into hunters. Like a spiral orchard of thorns around the harvest, the cost grows with every new identity, so cloning yourself only multiplies your bill, not your vote.
